## Synopsis

```text
perch outbound list [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Print recent outbound submissions, optionally filtered by account. --limit defaults to 100.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--account <value>` | filter by account email |
| `--limit <value>` | maximum rows (default: 100) |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch outbound list --limit 20
```
